intendedUse: Decide whether to expand or renew an AI tool across the organisation based on a reported average of four hours saved per person per week.
workflowBoundary: The tool changes selected knowledge-work tasks; time use, transferred review work, output volume or quality, downstream effects, full costs, risks, and alternatives are considered in the scale decision.
workflowCompletion: The scale decision is complete when the observed time change is connected to a defined organisational benefit and compared with the full relevant cost, risk, and reasonable alternatives.
movedBottleneck: Time removed from one task may reappear as review, coordination, waiting, or simply unused capacity; the conversion from saved time to realised benefit is the critical boundary.
unhappyPath: The organisation multiplies four hours by salary and headcount and calls the result Value even though the saved time was not redeployed, output did not increase, and review/support costs were omitted.

actors.role: Employees use the tool for bounded knowledge-work tasks and report or record time changes.

authority: Managers may decide how saved capacity is used; the local time observation does not itself authorise an enterprise-scale purchase.
accountability: The scale decision owner must connect the outcome evidence to realised benefit, full cost, risk, and alternatives.
demonstrated: A bounded illustrative measurement observed an average reduction of four hours per person per week on the selected tasks.
inferredOrAssumed: It is not yet established that those hours became additional useful output, reduced spend, shorter cycle time, better quality, or another realised benefit.
knownLimitations: Transferred review and coordination work is incomplete.
The full licence, integration, support, assurance, and change-management cost boundary is incomplete.
Reasonable alternatives and the status quo have not been compared on the same decision basis.
outcomeMeasure: Average time spent on the selected tasks per person per week under the defined measurement method.
baseline: The same selected tasks were measured before adoption using the same illustrative time-use definition.
fullRelevantCostBoundary: Enterprise licensing, integration, support, assurance, training/change effort, transferred review work, incident/recovery cost, and any material displacement effects.
evidenceRefs: Full-cost and alternative comparison not yet complete
nextEvidence: Measure what the saved capacity became, complete the full relevant cost and risk boundary, compare reasonable alternatives, and apply the pre-agreed scale/renew rule.
stopRule: Do not convert saved hours directly into monetary Value by multiplying by salary and headcount unless the mechanism from time saved to realised benefit is evidenced.
